ana: quick note — bringing up Raven-21b quant (per-tensor int4) on canary pool. Seeing fragmentation + intermittent OOMs when we use sliding-window attention with larger batches.

ana: repro config:
```
model: raven-21b
quant: int4
batch_size: 12
attn_mode: sliding
window: 1024
contiguous_alloc: false
prefetch: true
```

mike: thanks — can you paste the OOM log and p95 latency? also which CUDA kernel (triton/torch) are we on?

ana: OOM trace attached (snippet):
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 27.10 GiB already allocated)
Allocated by: attention_forward.cu:line 422
Tensor ptr: 0x7f8b...
```
p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 860ms during steady traffic; spikes to 2.1s right before OOM. Using triton kernels v1.3.

ops-bot: resource-alert: node-c45 killed process raven_canary_21b (OOM) at 2134568005

shiv: two quick hypotheses: 1) sliding window with window=1024 keeps more intermediate buffers live (not shard-friendly) so fragmentation grows; 2) int4 kernel path may allocate temp FP16 buffers for softmax/attn which defeats packing.

shiv: quick mitigations to test (low cost):
- drop window -> 512
- enable contiguous_alloc: true (reduce heap fragmentation)
- try batch_size 8 with dynamic_batching enabled

jana: also try switching attn_mode to "chunked" (chunk size 256) — chunked attention reduces peak working set at cost of some latency. can run a canary with these three variants.

mike: +1 to chunked. also run a baseline with per-channel quant (if available) — per-channel tends to reduce need for big temp buffers.

ana: will run canaries now:
- A: window=512, batch=12, contiguous_alloc=true
- B: chunked, chunk_size=256, batch=12
- C: window=1024, batch=8, contiguous_alloc=true, dynamic_batching=true

ana: quick note — enabling contiguous_alloc required bumping allocator flags in runtime:
```
--runtime.alloc_contiguous=true
--runtime.compaction_interval=60s
```

ops-bot: deploy: canary raven-21b variants A/B/C started on pool-canary-3 at 2134568050

mike: when you have A/B/C perf, please include p50/p95 and max resident memory (per-GPU) and fragmentation metric from our allocator (fragmentation = wasted_bytes/total_used).

ana: running. initial observations after 10k requests: 
- A: p95 780ms, max_rss 26.1 GiB, fragmentation 0.12
- B: p95 980ms, max_rss 24.6 GiB, fragmentation 0.07
- C: p95 910ms, max_rss 25.2 GiB, fragmentation 0.09

ana: notes — B (chunked) reduces memory and fragmentation but increases p95 slightly. A keeps latency best but fragmentation still nontrivial. C is middle ground. no OOMs in 10k requests.

shiv: sounds like chunked is safest for now. we can opt for chunked default for raven-21b quant until we upstream an int4 kernel that avoids temp buffers.

jana: Also add a startup compaction pass after model load (compaction_interval=0 for first 30s) to defragment once allocations stabilize. Small patch in runtime should help.

mike: action items: 
- ana: promote B to canary-prod with 100 qps for 24h and gather long-tail metrics
- eng-runtime: add contiguous_alloc default to true for quantized models and add one-time compaction after load
- eng-ml: try per-channel quant config on raven and rerun A/B

ana: ack — I'll kick off prod canary B and upload dashboard. will also attach eval diffs for quality regression (sampler vs baseline fp16).

ana: quick quality note — int4 per-tensor had a small BLEU-ish drop on long-context summarization (~1.8% lower on our eval set). per-channel looks promising (0.3% delta).

mike: thanks. prioritize memory stability first; we'll schedule per-channel quant roll for next week.

shiv: adding a small runtime guard: if fragmentation > 0.15 and p95 > 1s -> fallback to chunked or lower batch. That should stop OOM cascades.

ana: closing loop — after 24h canary B at 100 qps: no OOMs, p95 stable ~1.0s, fragmentation avg 0.06. pushing chunked as default for canary-prod.

mike: great. create a short runbook entry for raven-21b defaults (chunked, contiguous_alloc=true, compaction-first-30s) and mark model as "staged" in catalog until per-channel quant validated.

jana: I'll add the runbook and a config snippet to model catalog.

ana: thanks all. will file a follow-up to revisit once per-channel quant kernels are in mainline. :rocket:
